topic: Stages in the Life Cycle of Organisms
key_concepts: A life cycle is a period involving one generation of an organism and change of form, usual
Metamorphosis is a biological process by which an animal physically develops after birth o
Complete metamorphosis has four stages: egg, larva, pupa, and adult.
In complete metamorphosis, larvae hatch from eggs but do not look like adult insects.
The pupa stage is when larvae make a cocoon and change into their adult form without eatin
Incomplete metamorphosis has three stages: egg, nymph, and adult.
Nymphs look like small adults but usually do not have wings.
Adult insects are generally the only stage with wings and their primary interest is mating
Frogs lay eggs in water in a jelly-like egg mass fertilized by male sperm.
A tadpole has gills to breathe, a mouth to eat, and a tail to swim like a fish.
A tadpole develops hind legs, then lungs and forelimbs, and becomes an adult frog.
The chicken life cycle includes egg, hatching, chick, and adult hen or rooster.
